dataList.content:
Hello~?
嘿~

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
I'm talking to you, Heathcliff.
我在跟你说话呢，希斯克利夫。

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
...What.
……咋了。

It's a bright, sunny day in the City.
这是都市中阳光明媚的一天。

The child sat on a bench, wearing a pair of pitch black sunglasses.
那孩子坐在长椅上，戴着一副漆黑的墨镜。

Next to her was another child, totally confident that he didn't look suspicious in the slightest.
在她旁边的坐着的，是认为自己没有丝毫可疑之处的另一个孩子。

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
Do you seriously think you don't look suspicious with the way you're acting?
你真的认为这么做看起来不可疑吗？

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
...Long as you don't keep bugging me with the prattle. What, there a problem?
……如果你不对我一直叨叨扰扰的话就是了。咋了，有意见吗？

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
Yeah, I've got a problem. Who reads both pages of a newspaper like that in this day and age?
嗯，确实有。在这年头，谁还会像这样伸着胳膊看报纸呢？

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
If you're going to do that, at least stop peeking over the pages.
只是埋头看报就算了。为什么你还总是透过报纸偷瞟？

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
You're going to scare our VIP away, 'kay?
你会把我们的VIP吓跑的。懂吗？

The child sighed deeply, belittling her coworker.
那孩子一边责备她的同事一边长长地叹了口气。

The two children were conducting a covert mission. Specifically, it was 'appointed-persons protection', one of the Zwei's job categories.
这两个孩子正在执行一项便衣任务。具体来说叫作“保护指定人员”，是Zwei协会的工作类别之一。

It's a well-known fact that the Zwei Association specializes in client protection, but their exact methodology isn't so public.
众所周知，Zwei协会负责保护客户，但真正了解其工作具体形式的人并不多。

Covert supervision was one of those methodologies: a service for people who want protection without interruption to their daily lives.
便衣保护就是其中之一。这是为那些希望在不影响日常生活的情况下得到保护的人提供的服务。

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
Haah... Won't something please happen? Just dawdling here is starting to get boring.
哈……没有什么事发生吗~在这里坐着发呆实在太无聊了。

However, the child appears rather disgruntled.
但是，这孩子显得相当不满。

Understandably so, as she was assigned an appointed-persons protection job only because of her proclivity to act naturally in unfamiliar circumstances...
这也可以理解，她之所以被指派从事保护指定人员的工作，只是因为她在不熟悉的环境中可以表现得很自然……

Not because this was what she wanted to do per se.
并不是因为这本就是她想做的。

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
Ugh... I should've picked a different job. But this looked so cool on paper...
唉……我应该要选别的工作才是。但这在文件上描述得太酷了……

...Perhaps the child wasn't entirely free of fault.
……也许这孩子也不是完全没错。

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
…Hold on, he's on the move.
……等下，他开始移动了？

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
What? He's supposed to faff around there for another hour or... oi!
诶？他应该再在那待上一个小时或……喂！

The child next to her rose to his feet, crumpling the paper.
她旁边的孩子站了起来，并把报纸揉成一团。

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
Woohoo~ Something's finally happening!
好啊~终于有事发生了！

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
Blimey, speak of the devil...
哈，说啥来啥……

An excited child and a frustrated child...
一个兴奋的孩子，和一个沮丧的孩子……

The duo subtly strode up behind the VIP.
二人以巧妙的速度走到VIP的身后。

dataList.content:

W-What in the? I'm just here to meet someone for the contract payment...
什、什么？我只是来见交付合同款项的人……

dataList.content:
Meet someone? More like greet my blade. Now, say hello!
见什么人？不如来见我的刀。来，打个招呼吧！

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
A—Ahh...
啊、啊啊……

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
Alright, hold your horses!
好，到此为止！

A heavy thwack echoed through the narrow alley.
一阵沉重的打击声在狭窄的小巷中回荡。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
W—Who are?! Ah… The Zwei?
是、是谁？！啊……Zwei？

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
Yep~ Haven't seen each other since we signed the contract, eh?
没错~自打我们签了合同后就没见过面了吧？

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Where in the world were you...
你们到底是在哪……

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
Listen, can you stick to the routine you told us before~?
如果您的实际行动和告诉我们的行动计划差太多的话会很难办的~

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
It's not easy being stealthy around you when you veer off your usual course...
当您偏离常规路线时，想要在您周围不引人瞩目可不容易……

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
Anyways! From this point on, the Zwei's here to protect you!
总之！从现在起Zwei会在此保护您的安全~

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
Heath! Get this lout straight outta here~!
希斯！把这个没常识的混蛋收拾掉~

With that, the child stepped in front of the client with her characteristic defensive stance.
这孩子说完便站在客户身前，摆出一副特有的防御姿态。

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 5
Zwei协会 5科
dataList.content:
Alright, who's up next? Come on out!
好，其他人都在哪里？现在给我出来！

Grinning that there was finally something to do.
脸上挂着终于有事可做的喜悦笑容。
